// Run only from a separate module pinned to topology v0.1.0, never with replace.
package main

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "github.com/Leeminjing/go-forest/forest"
 "github.com/Leeminjing/go-forest/extensions/topology"
)
type number interface{ Number() int }
type value int
func(v value)Number()int{return int(v)}
type attempt struct{ Request topology.Request; Proposal topology.Proposal; Receipt topology.Receipt }
type evidence struct{ Seed topology.Receipt; Boot topology.Request; BootReceipt topology.Receipt; Attempts []attempt; Position topology.Position }
func must(err error){if err!=nil {panic(err)}}
func main(){
 ctx:=context.Background();dir:=os.Args[2];must(os.MkdirAll(dir,0700))
 block:=false
 regs:=[]topology.Registration{}
 for _,version:=range []string{"1","2","bad"}{ version:=version
  d:=forest.Definition{TypeID:"number",Version:version,HotSwappable:true,Capabilities:[]forest.CapabilityDescriptor{forest.Capability[number]("number",forest.Public)},Build:func(context.Context,*forest.BuildEnv)(forest.Lifecycle,error){panic("replaced below")}}
  d.Build=func(_ context.Context,env *forest.BuildEnv)(forest.Lifecycle,error){
   if block {fmt.Println("LEGACY_READY");var b [1]byte;_,_=os.Stdin.Read(b[:]);panic("kill barrier released")}
   return forest.Hooks{OnStart:func(context.Context)error{if version=="bad" {return errors.New("old native startup failure")};return nil}},forest.Provide(env,"number",value(7))
  }
  regs=append(regs,topology.Registration{Definition:d,ContractKey:"number/1",ImplementationDigest:strings.Repeat("a",64)})
 }
 catalog,err:=topology.NewCatalog(regs);must(err)
 m:=topology.Empty();m.Trees=append(m.Trees,topology.Tree{ID:"number",Definition:regs[0].Definition.Ref(),ContractKey:"number/1",ImplementationDigest:strings.Repeat("a",64)})
 store,err:=topology.Open(dir,topology.Options{});must(err)
 result:=evidence{Attempts:[]attempt{}}
 result.Seed,err=store.Seed(ctx,topology.Request{ID:"seed",Expected:store.Inspect().Position,Approval:"v0.1 producer"},m);must(err)
 c,err:=topology.NewController(forest.New(forest.Options{}),store,catalog);must(err)
 result.Boot=topology.Request{ID:"boot",Expected:store.Inspect().Position,Approval:"old cold restore"}
 result.BootReceipt,err=c.Restore(ctx,result.Boot);must(err)
 change:=func(id,version string,rollback bool){
  target:=m;target.Trees=append([]topology.Tree(nil),m.Trees...);target.Trees[0].Definition.Version=version
  p,e:=c.Preview(target);must(e);if rollback {p,e=c.PreviewRollback(result.Seed.Revision);must(e)}
  req:=topology.Request{ID:id,Expected:p.Expected,Approval:"v0.1 actual original request"}
  var r topology.Receipt
  if rollback {r,e=c.Rollback(ctx,req,p)}else{r,e=c.Reconfigure(ctx,req,p)}
  if version=="bad" {if !errors.Is(e,forest.ErrPrepareFailed){panic(e)}}else{must(e)}
  result.Attempts=append(result.Attempts,attempt{req,p,r})
 }
 if os.Args[1]=="pending" {block=true;change("pending-upgrade","2",false);panic("expected kill")}
 change("upgrade","2",false);change("noop","2",false);change("failed","bad",false);change("rollback","1",true)
 must(c.Close(ctx));result.Position=store.Inspect().Position
 data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(result,"","  ");must(err);must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"evidence.json"),data,0600))
 fmt.Println("LEGACY_DONE")
}
